hub.title: Image
hub.description: Manage the container images available in the current Workspace. Once registered, you can pick them directly when creating a dev instance, training job or inference service, without typing the URI by hand.
hub.unregisterDesc: This only removes the reference from this Workspace; the image in ECR is not deleted.

buildHistory.noLogs: (No logs yet; the build has just started or its logs have not been generated)

register.title: Register image
register.pickRepoAndTag: Select a repository and at least one tag.
register.uriHelp: You can register official AWS images (DLC / SageMaker), public.ecr.aws public images, or private images from other accounts. Note: when a task is created, the nodes of the cluster must have permission to pull the image.
register.displayNameHintBatch: (optional; ignored in bulk registration, where each tag name is used)

build.nameErr: Must start with a lowercase letter or digit, with single . _ - / separators in between (no uppercase, consecutive separators, or leading/trailing separators)
build.tagErr: Only letters, digits and . _ - are allowed (uppercase is allowed)
build.missingFields: Enter the Dockerfile, image name and tag.
build.nameInvalid: The image name format is invalid.
build.submitted: Build submitted. You can follow its progress in Build History.
build.title: Build image (Dockerfile → CodeBuild)
build.imageNameHint: Used directly as the ECR repository name; namespace/repo-name is recommended for easier grouping
build.imageNameRule: Start with a lowercase letter or digit; separate segments with . _ -, and use / for paths
build.dockerfileHint: For dev instance images, FROM sagemaker-distribution is recommended, otherwise the instance may fail to start; training and inference images are unrestricted
build.specHint: Maps to an AWS CodeBuild instance type (BUILD_GENERAL1_*)
build.specHelp: The bottleneck when building large images is disk (the docker build peak is about 2-3 times the final image), not memory. For images above 20GB, choose "2XLarge" (824GB disk). Billing is by build time, so larger specs cost more; choose what you need.
build.timeoutHint: The build fails if it does not finish in time. Default 120 minutes (2 hours), maximum 480 minutes (8 hours)
